common.tagline: Talk with AI. Keep every word.

metadata.title: MyVoiceLab — Talk with AI, keep every word
metadata.description: Talk with AI in any situation and turn what you said into something you can read. A new way to live — out loud.

hero.badge: No signup required — try it now
hero.subCopy1: A new way to live — out loud.
hero.subCopy2: A partner for practicing out loud, right here.
hero.note: No signup — free for your first 10 exchanges

steps.title: Speak it. Keep it. See it.

talk.title: Speak with your voice
talk.desc: Press the mic and say what's on your mind — no keyboard needed.

stack.title: Your conversation stays
stack.desc: Every exchange with the AI is saved automatically. You don't have to take notes — nothing gets lost.

visualize.title: See it take shape
visualize.desc: The conversation is summarized into a diary you can read later. What you said becomes something you can see.

features.title: Speak, keep it, and see it take shape.

voice.title: Speak with your voice
voice.desc: Start an AI conversation with a single tap. Whether it's reflection, working through an idea, or just chatting — begin with your voice.

conversation.title: Your conversation stays
conversation.desc: What you said is kept as a readable record. Speaking carries on where writing gives up.

summary.title: See it take shape
summary.desc: The AI summarizes your conversation. Your own words get organized into something you can read later.

cta.bodyLine1: No signup — free for your first 10 exchanges.
cta.bodyLine2: Just start by saying it out loud.

conversation.text: I couldn't say what I wanted in a meeting — I'm a bit drained.
We were split over priorities for a new feature, and I couldn't find the words.
Which priority feels right to you?

summaryDemo.title: Reflecting on the meeting
lines: We were divided on priorities in the meeting.
I felt drained — the words wouldn't come out.
For me, nailing down the experience comes first.

hub.heading: What would you like to talk about?

diary.title: Voice diary
diary.desc: Reflect on your day by talking with AI. What you said is kept in a form you can read later.

english.title: English conversation
english.desc: Practice speaking English. Talk with a character you like, at your own pace, in real time.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist, or may have moved.

prompt.heading: How about putting today into words?
